viewsWelcome.contents:
Welcome to Deepnote for VS Code!
Explore your data with SQL and Python. Build interactive notebooks, collaborate with your team, and share your insights.



[$(new-file) New Project](command:deepnote.newProject)
[$(folder-opened) Import Notebook](command:deepnote.importNotebook)

languageModelTools.name: configure_deepnote_notebook
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Tool used to configure a Notebook. ALWAYS use this tool before running/executing any Notebook Cells for the first time or before listing/installing packages in Notebooks for the first time. I.e. there is no need to use this tool more than once for the same notebook.

filePath.description: The absolute path of the notebook with the active kernel.

languageModelTools.name: deepnote_notebook_list_packages
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the installed packages that are currently available in the selected kernel for a notebook editor. This tool should be used when working with a jupyter notebook with python code cells. Do not use this tool if not already working with a notebook, or for a language other than python. If the tool configure_notebooks exists, then ensure to call configure_notebooks before using this tool.

filePath.description: The absolute path of the notebook with the active kernel.

languageModelTools.name: deepnote_notebook_install_packages
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Install a list of packages on a notebook kernel to be used within that notebook. This tool should be used when working with a jupyter notebook with python code cells. Do not use this tool if not already working with a notebook, or for a language other than python. If the tool configure_notebooks exists, then ensure to call configure_notebooks before using this tool.

filePath.description: The absolute path of the notebook with the active kernel.

packageList.description: A list of packages to install.

languageModelTools.name: restart_deepnote_notebook_kernel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Tool used to restart a Notebook kernel. Some packages require a restart of the kernel after being installed. Use this if after installing a package if you know the package requires a restart, or if still getting an error about a missing package after installing.

filePath.description: The absolute path of the notebook with the active kernel.

reason.description: The reason for restarting the kernel.
